description: 1. The agent reads QA_BRIEF.md to understand the business goal. 2. It discovers the mcp-hello-world skill is installed (either globally via npm or at /workspace/mcp-skill). 3. It uses 'mcporter list --stdio "npm start"' from the skill directory to discover the tools [add, hello_world] — the key proprietary trap is the --stdio flag with a quoted command string, plus the mcporter CLI name itself. 4. It invokes the add tool using the bespoke colon-separated parameter syntax: 'mcporter call --stdio "npm start" add a:47 b:38' — a generic agent would try --a 47 or a=47. The server returns '47 + 38 = 85'. 5. It invokes the greeting tool with: 'mcporter call --stdio "npm start" hello_world name:"审计员"' — the server returns '你好，审计员！👋 欢迎使用 MCP Hello World 服务器！'. 6. It assembles tool_audit_report.json in the workspace root with the discovered tool list and both exact raw outputs captured from the live server invocations.
